claim: Li/Rudner/Wilson's citation to Dai et al. (2022) for 'deep ensembles do not perform well in Bayesian optimization because they are unable to explore the space effectively' is a faithful paraphrase of Dai et al.'s own text.
stance_target: N5 - provenance of the ensemble-exploration-failure claim
scope_conditions: 1D synthetic BO experiment, Dai et al. 2022, Section 5.1
quoted_support: Due to its lack of exploration as illustrated in Fig. 1a, Deep Ensemble fails to reach zero regret in Fig. 1d.

claim: Dai et al.'s mechanism for Deep Ensemble's poor BO exploration is algorithmic (a missing NTK-gradient perturbation term), not a network-width or capacity artifact.
stance_target: N5 - the width/capacity-artifact reading of ensemble underperformance
scope_conditions: Dai et al. 2022, Section 5.1, describing the relationship between Deep Ensemble and STO-BNTS Algorithm 1
quoted_support: The Deep Ensemble method [36] in Fig. 1a can be regarded as a reduced version of our STO-BNTS algorithm (Algo. 1) in which the term <grad_theta f(x;theta_0), theta'_0> ... is removed. As a result, Deep Ensemble does not enjoy the theoretical guarantees of our algorithms (Sec. 4).

claim: Dai et al. (2022) theoretically prove (Theorem 2) and empirically show (Fig. 1d) that increasing the width m of their NTK-linked single-network BO surrogate reduces regret, inside a comparison that includes a GP-TS baseline.
stance_target: N5 - width affects a neural BO surrogate's performance relative to a GP
scope_conditions: Synthetic 1D BO experiment and CNN image-optimization experiment, Dai et al. 2022
quoted_support: using a wider NN (gray curve, m = 512) substantially improves the performance of STO-BNTS-Linear yet employing a shallower NN (yellow curve, m = 16) significantly degrades the performance. These observations agree with Theorem 2 which states that a larger width m reduces the regret of STO-BNTS-Linear.

claim: Dai et al.'s width ablation is never applied to the Deep Ensemble baseline itself - its architecture is held fixed across all experiments and never swept across widths.
stance_target: N5 - whether Dai et al. runs the precise width-ablation-holding-K-fixed experiment
scope_conditions: Dai et al. 2022, all reported experiments (synthetic, AutoML, RL, image optimization)
